source: Client-provided color references and provisional calibration values.

registration.sensingCircleDimensionMeaning: diameter of the sensing circle shown by the 5 mm extension lines
registration.spacingInterpretation: ambiguous-edge-versus-center; use normalized schematic relationships until client confirms dimension-line convention
registration.orientation: square-side -> Nitrite circle -> pH circle -> triangle -> handle

roi.note: Production analysis registers the square and triangle reference marks and locates separate Nitrite (left) and pH (right) circles using the client schematic. Template-relative coordinates are not independent millimetre measurements. The legacy fallback is ignored in production and retained only for isolated developer fixtures.

pH.method: RGB median -> CIE Lab D65 -> nearest reference by CIEDE2000
pH.reliabilityNote: No client-approved pH acceptance threshold is available. Production analysis must remain unreliable until a provisional threshold is explicitly configured and validated against paired standards.

clientRgbRanges.usage: active provisional RGB interval; not analytically validated
active provisional RGB interval; not analytically validated

clientRgbRanges.sourceNote: PH3_BLUE_SOURCE_ORDER_REVERSED: client supplied B range was written as 116-113; normalized only for interval testing.
clientRgbRanges.usage: active provisional RGB interval; not analytically validated
active provisional RGB interval; not analytically validated

continuousModel.source: Client-confirmed official-time labels from 45 physical µPAD captures; fitted on the 43 registered, image-quality-eligible official-time ROI colors.
continuousModel.method: sRGB median ROI -> CIE Lab D65 -> standardized degree-2 Lab features -> ridge regression (alpha 0.01)

colorDomain.margin: 2 Lab units beyond the minimum and maximum of the 43 eligible official-time training ROIs

continuousModel.outputPolicy: Reject colors outside colorDomain; clamp accepted regression values to supportedPH because no verified real-camera labels exist beyond that interval.

validation.method: 5-repeat nested stratified 5-fold grouped cross-validation; inner selection used 3 repeats of 4-fold sample-grouped CV; class used for fold stratification and reporting only, never as a model feature.
validation.note: Three class-level laboratory labels are available; within-class individual-strip pH labels were not supplied. Validation does not establish 0.05-pH resolution or transfer to unrepresented water, camera, or pH conditions.

nitrite.reaction: Griess method, client-provided direct Nitrite reference colors
nitrite.method: Registered left Nitrite ROI median RGB -> discrete client-reference matching using exact RGB intervals and a guarded three-metric centroid score

matching.acceptance: A unique inclusive client RGB interval match is strongest. Otherwise, a discrete class is accepted only when a three-metric centroid score is within the configured limit, has the required runner-up margin, and stays within the reference color family.
matching.distanceMetric: Equal-weight mean of CIEDE2000, RGB Euclidean distance, and normalized chromatic RGB distance, each divided by its median pairwise centroid separation
matching.estimateUse: reference-color-based estimate; laboratory accuracy is not established

nitrite.outOfRange: Return null with NITRITE_OUTSIDE_CALIBRATION_RANGE or NITRITE_MEASUREMENT_UNRELIABLE; never interpolate or clamp.

researchMetadata.note: HSV H/S/V remain diagnostics only until client-specific calibration validates a production model.

legacyNitrateNitriteEquivalentReference.source: Historical client-provided reference table; not used for current Nitrite output.
